# Red-dead-X: MAX OPERATIONAL FORENSIC PLATFORM

## Capabilities Spec
This project is an all-gas, no-brakes forensic platform for smart contracts and DeFi protocols.
It exports all supported chains, contract types, analytic/attack tools, and data ingestion/export modalities.
It is instantly consumable by every AI coding assistant (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains, WindSurf, CodeEdit, Claude, ChatGPT, Thirdweb Agent, Web IDEs).

## Features
- **UNIVERSAL CHAIN INTEGRATION:** Ethereum, Solana, BSC, Base, AVAX, Sui, Aptos, Polygon, Cosmos, ZK-rollups.
- **AUTO-DISCOVERY:** thirdweb MCP/Registry API, direct chain/cross-chain inventory, bug bounty program feeds.
- **TOOLCHAIN:** Base64/32/85/91, ASCII, Hex, URL, JWT, JSON, TOML, YAML, diff, validation.
- **ECONOMIC SIM:** Uniswap, Balancer, Curve, Sushi, Solend, DA pricing.
- **MCP/SDK INTEGRATION:** thirdweb, Ethers, Web3, Alchemy, Infura, Go-ethereum, Solana.js.
- **FORENSIC MODULES:** Surface Mapper, Evidence Export (SARIF, JSON, Markdown), Attack Plan Simulator.
- **ALL-GAS MODE:** No simulation, no stale data. Always connected to live chains.
- **PLUGIN MODULARITY:** Direct integrations with JetBrains and VSCode plugins.
